fcc_description: Given a string of numbers separated by commas, return an array of the numbers sorted from smallest to largest.
fcc_js_tests:
[{"text": "

sortNumbers(\"3,1,2\") should return [1, 2, 3].

", "testString": "assert.deepEqual(sortNumbers(\"3,1,2\"), [1, 2, 3]);"}, {"text": "
